title: Multi-step Form
content: Build multi-step form wizard. Progress: step indicator showing current position. Steps: multiple form sections as steps. Navigation: Next/Previous buttons. Validation: validate current step before proceeding. Summary: review step before submission. Persistence: save progress between steps. Animation: smooth transition between steps.

variants.simple: Create wizard form with steps and progress indicator.
variants.detailed: Build multi-step form wizard. Progress: step indicator showing current position. Steps: multiple form sections as steps. Navigation: Next/Previous buttons. Validation: validate current step before proceeding. Summary: review step before submission. Persistence: save progress between steps. Animation: smooth transition between steps.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive multi-step form wizard. Progress indicator: horizontal steps with numbers or icons, connector lines between, current step highlighted, completed steps with checkmark, step labels below. Step display: one step visible at a time, or accordion-style with collapsed completed steps. Form sections: each step contains related fields, independent validation per step. Navigation buttons: "Previous" and "Next" buttons, "Next" validates current step before proceeding, "Previous" preserves entered data. Validation: validate only current step fields on next, show errors inline, prevent advancement until valid. Step state: track current step index, completed steps set, form data object. URL sync: optionally update URL with step (?step=2) for bookmarking and refresh survival. Persistence: save form data to localStorage or sessionStorage between steps, restore on page refresh. Summary step: final step shows all entered data for review, edit buttons per section to jump back. Submission: submit button on final step, handle loading state, success/error feedback. Animation: slide or fade transition between steps, direction based on navigation (left for next, right for prev). Progress saving: periodic auto-save of form data, "Draft saved" indicator. Exit warning: beforeunload prompt if form has unsaved changes. Skip optional steps: mark steps as optional, allow skipping. Conditional steps: show/hide steps based on previous answers. Accessibility: announce step changes, proper heading hierarchy per step, focus management. Mobile: stack steps vertically on mobile, full-width navigation. Error recovery: save state on error, restore to continue.
